t71xx_secifsv.headline: AI Detected
flagged: AI-Generated (65 words): A grown-up you can trust gets built through care and boundaries, and through action and direction. So what if you go looking for that calm Self and find nobody home? That's what borrowing's for. Maybe a friend plays Protector for a night, or the phone gets to ring when you know how that call goes, like back in The Parent You Inherited.

AI-Generated (141 words): Then there's "unburdening," where the outline says parts can be helped to drop their burdens and "return to their natural balance," often after you've witnessed a part's origin story. That can be powerful. It can also get dramatic, with a lot of focus on memories and plenty of room for suggestion, and that can knock people off balance, especially if they tend to dissociate (DID-like fragmentation included) or to spiritually bypass.
And the map? It keeps expanding: managers, firefighters, exiles, polarized parts, legacy burdens, Self-energy, guides, new subparts... That's a lot of rooms to get lost in. Some practitioners use the model gently. Others seem to leave people more fragmented while trying to fix the fragmenting. And having institutes and certifications behind a framework doesn't make it any truer, or safer for that matter.
